schema: frozen original-only dry baseline reconstruction proposal v1

baseline_command.admission: Exact byte identity only. If it differs, preserve output/receipt and stop; no gain fit, alignment, parameter retuning or conversion to a loose metric gate.

limits.timeout_policy: Use one global 60-second deadline across the serial compile/link phase, with the shorter per-command cap. If any command fails or times out, preserve all outputs/logs and stop without retry. Kill only that command-owned process group if timeout termination is needed.

pre_execution_gates: Root explicitly authorizes this frozen proposal.
Reverify the proposal, wrapper, all 39 staged inputs, three derived numeric fixtures and tool/runtime identities.
Recheck current separate-local capacity; the recorded snapshot is not a reservation.
Confirm every build/output path is new and retain separate stdout/stderr/receipt for every attempt.
post_link_gates: All explicit compile/link commands succeeded within the global limit.
All required original definitions are present; all forbidden candidate/runtime definitions are absent from all defined symbols.
Only the exact 18 declared workspace objects entered the link.
Every loaded runtime identity matches the frozen runtime pins.
after_baseline: Verify raw output length and exact SHA-256 before any interpretation.
Report actual process/retained/warmup counts and nonfinite counts; no full-voice candidate comparison was performed by the reconstruction check.
If exact, send only numeric/reference identity evidence to root. Do not run another capture automatically.
historical_identity_limit: The historical missing scheduler object and two still-needed historical header identities have not been recovered. Rebuild all selected units from the single consistent staged source tree. No differently hashed C++ object is silently substituted.
